curation.notes: FluidFM-based AFM single-cell force spectroscopy measuring detachment of RPE-1 LifeAct-mCherry cells from fibronectin after treatment with the actin stabilizer miuraenamide A (MiuA) vs DMSO. SCFS is one of several assays (focal adhesion staining, contractility screening, microchannel migration); only the SCFS part is force spectroscopy.

hardware.model_number: Nanowizard IV XP with CellHesion 200 head; Cytosurge FluidFM V2 Platinum

evidence.snippet: We performed single-cell force measurements at 37 °C using a Nanowizard IV XP AFM with a CellHesion 200 Head (Bruker-JPK, Santa Barbara, CA, USA)
Cytosurge FluidFM micropipette (aperture 4 µm, stiffness 2 N/m)
We then detached the cells from the fibronectin by retracting the micropipette (z-length 50 µm, z-velocity 0.8 µm/s).

attachment_chemistry: FluidFM vacuum aspiration of cell to micropipette (−500 mbar)

evidence.snippet: We then detached the cells from the fibronectin by retracting the micropipette (z-length 50 µm, z-velocity 0.8 µm/s).
